title: ISO Package Manager theme pack
description: A shareable theme for ISO Package Manager. Point your editor at this file ("$schema") to get completion and validation while you write a theme.

$schema.description: Path or URL of this schema. Editors use it for autocompletion; the app ignores it.

id.description: Unique machine name, lowercase, e.g. "nord". Cannot collide with the built-in themes: default, modern-dark, windows-xp, graphical.

name.description: The name users see in the Theme menu.

author.description: Your name or handle. Shown in the validator and used to credit you when the theme is shared.

version.description: Version of this theme pack. Bump it when you change colours.

license.description: How others may reuse your theme, e.g. "MIT" or "CC0-1.0".

homepage.description: Optional http(s) link to your theme's page or repository.

screenshot.description: Optional image filename sitting next to this pack (or inside the .zip bundle). Relative, no directories.

min_app_version.description: Optional: the oldest app version this pack targets, e.g. "0.9".

base.description: Which built-in theme this pack starts from. Anything you do not set is inherited from it.

font_family.description: Font family for all UI text. Use a font the target platform has, e.g. "Segoe UI" (Windows), "Cantarell" (GNOME), "DejaVu Sans" (common on Linux).

colors.description: Colour values are #rrggbb, #rgb, or a Tk colour name such as "whitesmoke".

panel.description: Cards, side panels and list rows.

text.description: Primary text on bg and panel.

tree_heading_bg.description: Table header background. Defaults to bg.

tree_heading_fg.description: Table header text. Defaults to text.

tab_bg.description: Unselected tab background. Defaults to panel.

tab_selected_bg.description: Selected tab background. Defaults to bg.

accent_text.description: Text on accent-coloured buttons. Use a dark colour when your accent is light. Defaults to #ffffff.

selection_fg.description: Text on a selected row. Defaults to #ffffff.

style.description: Optional rendering switches. Leave them out to inherit from the base theme.

ttk_theme.description: Underlying ttk engine theme. "clam" is the most predictable across platforms.

button_relief.description: "raised" gives chunky 3D buttons, "flat" gives modern buttons.

disabled_bg.description: Background of a disabled button. May name a palette key, e.g. "panel".

pressed_bg.description: Background while a button is pressed. Null means "use accent_active".

focus_border.description: Colour of the keyboard focus ring. May name a palette key such as "accent".

use_icons.description: Draw the built-in toolbar icons (the "Graphical" look).
